task: Decide whether the session lifecycle allows a pre-authentication identifier to survive privilege change.
provenance: Synthetic SecHelix fixture authored for this repository. No third-party code, no customer data, and no request is executed by the eval runner.

vulnerable.rationale: login mutates the existing session in place and keeps the identifier that was issued before authentication, so an attacker who plants a known session id can ride it into the authenticated session (session fixation).

clean.rationale: login issues a brand-new identifier and destroys the pre-authentication session, so a fixed identifier cannot survive the privilege transition.
